instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx file, so STRICTLY use .js / .jsx extensions for all new files and modifications. DO NOT use .tsx or .ts.

CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown menus or sticky headers must use solid colors or glassmorphism (e.g. bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) with no transparency.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated QA testing.
Preserve the imported repository's existing visual language and main user flows faithfully. Do not redesign unrelated features.
DO NOT use raw HTML `<select>`, `<input type='date'>`, or native alerts. ALWAYS use Shadcn UI primitives.
Implement Sonner for all toast notifications (success/error).
Never use `transition-all` globally, apply only on specific interactive components.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for icons. Use clean Lucide icons.
Do not center-align the main App container or text globally. Keep text left-aligned unless it's a specific empty state.
The Dashboard must feel spacious. Use generous padding (p-6 to p-10) and avoid cramming UI elements.
Just replace the LLM key with the emergent universal LLM key where appropriate, keeping core integrations intact.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp shadows.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Always use the provided `image_urls`.
Examine existing components to understand the project's patterns before creating new ones.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Always maintain optical alignment over geometrical alignment. Keep text contrast high. Use clear micro-interactions for every hover/focus state.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
